finding.summary: Whole-column/whole-row expansion can include the formula's own cell, creating a self-reference the engine never had to handle
finding.evidence: `expandUnboundedRanges(cell.f!, await sheet.getUsedBounds())` clamps to bounds computed *including the formula cell itself*. `=SUM(1:1)` entered in D1 expands to `SUM(A1:D1)`, and `=SUM(A:A)` entered in A5 expands to `SUM(A1:A5)` — the formula depends on itself. `buildDependantsMap` will then record `A5 -> {A5}` (self edge), which either trips the cycle path or re-dirties the cell indefinitely. Excel reports a circular reference here; the new tests deliberately place every formula outside the referenced column/row (`=SUM(1:1)` at r2c4, `=SUM(A:A)` at c4), so this path is untested.
